method: Static inspection of the pre-7G frontend and committed Concept 7F communication, navigation, task, and debt audits. This records product copy and state transitions; it is not a runtime or screenshot measurement.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Result metrics and map layers were visible; the Run identity was not adjacent to them.
observations.scenarioVersionContext: Scenario and Version were available in Scenario or Run details, not persistently in the header.
observations.runIdentity: Durable Run history retained a record, but the active result did not identify it.
observations.staleBehavior: Not applicable until a later plan edit.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Map result artifacts were invalidated; the retained Run was not named in the workspace.
observations.scenarioVersionContext: No persistent Scenario or Version cue.
observations.runIdentity: Retained in Run History but not surfaced beside the stale state.
actionTargets: Run Sector or evaluate the changed plan
observations.staleBehavior: No automatic rerun; result layers were invalidated.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Optimization metrics and solution roles were visible; source Run and Version were not unified with them.
observations.runIdentity: Optimization Run was stored but not shown in one shared result header.
observations.staleBehavior: Result content was cleared on plan invalidation.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Run facts and retained summary were available; historical state was not a shared badge.
observations.scenarioVersionContext: Available in lineage detail when the Run was bound to a saved Version.
observations.staleBehavior: Opening a Run did not activate its source Scenario as the current working draft.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Public solutions and recommendation role were inspectable; no common source/destination confirmation preceded Apply.
observations.scenarioVersionContext: Available in Run/Scenario lineage detail when retained.
observations.staleBehavior: Historical solution identity existed, but action target needed clearer confirmation.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Report source binding was retained, but ordinary Report presentation exposed storage terminology and metadata.
observations.scenarioVersionContext: Stored in report definition/artifact binding; not led with consistently in the selected Report view.
observations.staleBehavior: A live compatibility Report could be generated from a draft without clear saved-Version wording.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: The Report builder used the source Run and ScenarioRevision; source confirmation was not a distinct user step.
observations.freshnessLabel: Historical meaning lived in implementation/source metadata
observations.scenarioVersionContext: Exact binding retained, but not summarized before generation.
observations.staleBehavior: No RF rerun was required; current draft/source separation was not explicit in the UI.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: Some feature limitations and research/reference scope were stated in local notes and titles.
observations.scenarioVersionContext: Not applicable to all reference cards.
actionTargets: Run an isolated reference where supported
observations.staleBehavior: Unsupported, unavailable, and research-only semantics were not one consistent visual/text system.

observations.visibleSourceIdentity: A rail symbol, disabled action, generic unavailable text, or panel-specific message could appear.
observations.runIdentity: May be absent or unavailable when data was not retained.
observations.staleBehavior: Unavailable was not consistently separated from unsupported.

primaryRisks: Users could interpret a prior Run as current after changing the plan.
Users could not answer which Scenario, Version, and Run owned a result without opening multiple panels.
Apply and historical Report actions did not make source and destination equally explicit.
Unavailable and unsupported states could be confused.
baselineConclusion: The application already invalidated stale map/result data and retained durable lineage. The missing layer was a shared, persistent user-facing identity and state vocabulary.
